purpose: Pilot-scoped, NON-OPERATIONAL concept-level SCIENTIFIC claims for molybdenum_disulfide, with provenance corrected: retrieval artifact (COD database record) is distinguished from originating scientific work; independence is judged on originating_work lineage. Supporting evidence IDs are mandatory. Claim approval does not authorize publication. The German lexical chain is untouched and supports none of these claims.
provenance_model: Each COD source is a crystallographic_database retrieval artifact carrying originating_work_id; the original article excerpts carry the same originating_work_id and therefore do NOT independently corroborate the COD records (lineage dedup). Independence for sufficiency = distinct originating_work.

claims.statement: The formula of molybdenum disulfide is MoS2.
claims.wording_note: Reworded from 'has the molecular formula MoS2' to avoid implying a discrete molecular solid; the PubChem source field name 'MolecularFormula' is preserved verbatim in the evidence locator, unchanged.
claims.sufficiency: primary_plus_corroborating satisfied (two independent government databases: PubChem + NIST)
claims.scope_guard: Chemical composition identity only. Not structure, not a physical property.

claims.statement: Bulk MoS2 is a layered material. In the 2H polytype, MoS2 has a hexagonal P63/mmc (No. 194) structure with lattice parameters near a ~ 3.15-3.16 A and c ~ 12.3 A in the admitted bulk crystallographic determinations.

layered.note: Directly evidenced (RSC review: S-Mo-S stacks; Acta 1983 excerpt: layered dichalcogenide). 'layered' is retained. Huang thesis is supporting provenance only.

2h_naming_polytype.note: 1T/2H/3R framework (RSC) + explicit 2H/3R terminology (Acta 1983 excerpt). Dickinson & Pauling 1923 did NOT use the modern '2H' label and is NOT cited for the 2H name.

space_group_lattice.note: Two INDEPENDENT originating determinations (WORK-DICKINSON-PAULING-1923 via COD 1010993; WORK-SCHONFELD-HUANG-MOSS-1983 via COD 9007660) + RSC as secondary corroboration. The excerpts share lineage with the COD records and do not double-count.

claims.polytype_scope: 2H is the claimed polytype. 3R (R3m, a ~ 3.17 A, c ~ 18.38 A) is a DISTINCT polytype documented separately in EVD-MOS2-3R-BOUNDARY-RSC and must not be conflated with the 2H claim; 1T and monolayer/few-layer forms are out of scope.
not_inferred: Dickinson & Pauling 1923 explicitly using the modern label '2H'
all MoS2 forms sharing one structure

claims.pilot_claim: C — one physical property (lattice parameter a of bulk 2H-MoS2)
claims.statement: The in-plane hexagonal lattice parameter a of bulk 2H-MoS2 is reported by independent determinations as 3.15(2) A (Dickinson & Pauling 1923 lineage) and 3.161 A (Schonfeld, Huang & Moss 1983 lineage).
claims.sufficiency: primary_plus_corroborating satisfied via two DISTINCT originating works (lineage-independent); values preserved separately (no averaging, no canonical scalar)
claims.form_scope: 2H bulk ONLY. A monolayer/few-layer or 3R value must never substitute for this.
claims.numeric_normalization: NUM-EN-DOT-DECIMAL; source_literal vs normalized_value distinct; uncertainty 3.15(2) -> 3.15 A +/- 0.02 A preserved; no unit conversion.
claims.coexistence_note: The two values (3.15(2) A and 3.161 A) are INDEPENDENT/COEXISTING determinations, not a material conflict (they agree within uncertainty). Not labelled a conflict.

band_gap_out_of_scope.note: The RSC review contains band-gap discussion (2H bulk indirect; monolayer direct). NO band-gap Claim D is activated in this closure. Band gap remains future work; Pilot 03 stays limited to Claims A/B/C.
